answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: every agent's earnings accrue to a locked balance released linearly over many epochs, so an attacker who flash-farms with thousands of fake identities must keep each identity honest and active until vesting completes. Misbehavior at any point, or abandonment of an account, forfeits all unvested rewards. The attacker's cost is the delta between stolen value and locked capital plus opportunity cost across every echo of the attack, and returns collapse to a nadir
